parameters.query: SELECT q.id entity_id,q.version,COALESCE(MAX(a.attempt_number),0)+1 attempt_number FROM quotes q LEFT JOIN delivery_attempts a ON a.entity_id=q.id AND a.entity_type='quote' WHERE q.status IN('approved','sent') AND(a.id IS NULL OR(a.status='retry'AND a.next_retry_at<=now()))GROUP BY q.id,q.version FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 25;

INSERT INTO quote_acceptance_tokens(quote_id,quote_version,token_hash,expires_at)VALUES($1,$2,$3,now()+interval '14 days')ON CONFLICT(quote_id,quote_version)DO UPDATE SET token_hash=CASE WHEN quote_acceptance_tokens.used_at IS NULL THEN EXCLUDED.token_hash ELSE quote_acceptance_tokens.token_hash END,expires_at=CASE WHEN quote_acceptance_tokens.used_at IS NULL THEN EXCLUDED.expires_at ELSE quote_acceptance_tokens.expires_at END RETURNING token_hash;

parameters.body: ={{JSON.stringify({attempt:$('Issue One Time Acceptance Token').item.json.attempt_number,acceptanceToken:$('Issue One Time Acceptance Token').item.json.token,simulate:$json.simulate??''})}}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO delivery_attempts(entity_type,entity_id,attempt_number,status,error_code,next_retry_at)VALUES('quote',$1,$2,$3,$4,CASE WHEN $3='retry'THEN now()+make_interval(secs=>$5)END)ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;UPDATE quotes SET status=CASE WHEN $3='delivered'THEN'sent'ELSE status END,updated_at=now()WHERE id=$1;INSERT INTO dead_letter_events(entity_type,entity_id,reason,payload)SELECT'quote',$1,'delivery_exhausted',jsonb_build_object('status',$4)WHERE $3='dlq';
